controls.title: Controls
controls.idleHint: Click a key slot to rebind
controls.captureHint: Press any key, Esc to cancel, Backspace to clear

first_catch.description: Speak with the Fisherman, then catch your first fish.

travellers_errand.description: Talk to the Traveller, then report to the Guard.

heed_the_warning.description: Talk to the Guard, survive for 60 seconds in the danger zone, then return to the Guard.

anti_death_measures.description: Talk to the Merchant, harvest yekberries, then return to the Merchant.

merchant_side_brew.description: Learn food refinement from the Merchant: stomp dropped yekberries into liquid, bottle it with a jar, then report back.

village_weirdo.description: Talk to the Traveller, collect 1 yekberry, then return for your reward.

wares_galore.description: Talk to the Merchant about your new coin and hear about his wares.

bowl_that_shines.description: Speak with the Wise Man and follow his lead to the Sea Master.

bowlThatShines.travellerHint: Hm... I wonder if the traveller has had the info all along.
bowlThatShines.returnToSeamaster: Show the Sea Master what you found.

rod.openInventory: To equip your new rod, open your inventory (press {key} on desktop).
rod.openInventoryMobile: To equip your new rod, tap the inventory button.
rod.selectRod: Click your rod in the inventory to select it.
rod.equipRod: Click the rod equipment slot on the right to equip it.
rod.closeInventoryMobile: Tap the inventory button again to close your inventory.

fishing.useRod: You're near water. Press {key} (desktop) or click the rod button to start fishing.
fishing.holdCast: Hold the cast button for a few seconds, then release.
fishing.reel: Click the reel button repeatedly until you catch the fish.
fishing.stop: Great catch! Click Stop Fishing, then talk to the Fisherman.

food.openInventoryMobile: Open your inventory to get your berry ready.
food.selectBerry: Click the yekberries in your inventory.
food.explainScore: That red +20 is the food score. In this basic form, yekberries only heal about 1 out of 5 uses.
food.equipQuickslot1: Move the yekberries into quick slot 1 on the right.
food.closeInventoryMobile: Close your inventory to try the quick slot.
food.stabHeartLoss: STAB! You just lost a heart! Now we'll use the berry to heal up.
food.consumeQuickslot1: Now click quick slot 1 to eat. This tutorial forces a heal so you can see it, but +20 food score normally means about a 1/5 chance.

interaction.useInteract: Use this interact button for most world and character interactions.

greeting.0: Hey! Nice timing, I was just polishing my knife.

choice.askRod: Can I get a fishing rod?

hasRod.0: Good to see you already geared up. Go reel in something sharp!

noRod.0: Well hello there! You look unarmed. Take this fishing rod.

hasRod.0: Hey now... I ALREADY GAVE YOU A ROD! NOW SCRAM!!!

noRod.0: Ugh, fine. But you better not mess up my fishing spot!

greeting.0: Tides are honest. Keep your blade sharp, and your heart sharper.

passphrase.prompt: If you have business with me, say it plainly.

choice.1: The collector of glass sent me.

wrong.0: What?? Is that supposed to mean something to me? SCRAM KID!
wrong.1: What?? Is that supposed to mean something to me? SCRAM KID!

story.0: The Wise Man would only hand out that code if he trusted you.
story.1: Listen closely. I used to be an archaeologist in the desert, always setting out on expeditions.
story.2: One day, I found a chest unlike anything I'd seen.
story.3: My top-secret sources said the key to that chest, the Glimmering Chest, was likely lost somewhere in the desert.
story.4: So I brought the chest to Anchor Hollow and stayed. I set my sights on the sea and learned every current I could.
story.5: In trying to find that key, I became the Sea Master.
story.6: And now I grant you the privilege of helping me search for it.
story.7: I know it's somewhere around the docks.
story.8: You might ask around Anchor Hollow for new rumors... though avoid the Traveller. She's suspicious. Weird.

choice.justMet: ... I kinda met him 30 seconds ago
choice.pals: Yes, we've been pals for life!

choiceResponse.justMet: Thirty seconds? Hmph. Then your timing is suspiciously perfect.
choiceResponse.pals: Pals for life, huh? You don't look old enough for that claim.

player.0: What info have you collected so far?

postKey.0: By the rolling tide... that's the Glimmering Key.
postKey.1: I am genuinely impressed. You found what I could not.
postKey.2: And here's the twist: keep the treasure for yourself. I've taken enough from the sea in my lifetime.
postKey.3: The chest is waiting. Go open it.

finalPlaceholder.0: So, what did the chest reveal? Hah, don't tell me yet.
finalPlaceholder.1: We'll speak again soon. For now, let this be your beginning.

greeting.0: Stay sharp. Anchor Hollow is peaceful, but peace is work.

preUnlock.0: It's not safe out here... GET BACK TO TOWN!

bridgeBlocked.0: HOLD YOUR HORSES! Who said you could cross this bridge?

intro.0: WOAH! Where do you think you're going??
intro.1: Well, what do you think is over there? A fancy hotel? Look kid, you aren't ready for what's across this bridge
intro.3: Okay fine. If you're really so tough, cross this bridge, and stay a while. Let's say... 60 seconds. Sound good?

choice.exploring: Uhhh... I'm just exploring I guess?

wait.0: Cross this bridge, survive 60 seconds in the danger zone, then report back to me.

return.0: WHAT?? How did you survive that???
return.1: Well, color me impressed. Not many in our town could survive out there...
return.2: Tell you what, If you gear up right, and show me that you're ready, I'll help you learn how to fight these evil beasts.
return.3: Don't worry, you'll know when you are ready. Until then, good luck.

post.0: Come back when you are ready... you're not quite there yet.

greeting.0: Easy now. The fish bite when the water is calm and the hands are patient.
If your pack feels light, my stall can fix that.

intro.1: Then let's start with money. You got any?
intro.3: How are you even surviving in Anchor Hollow?
intro.4: I'm new here. Still figuring things out.
intro.5: Alright, I'll help. Find a nearby Yekbush and grab some yekberries for a barely nourishing meal.
intro.6: Bring them back to me when you've harvested one.

harvest.0: Find a nearby Yekbush and gather some yekberries. Barely nourishing, but enough to keep you alive.
harvest.1: Come back once you've picked a bush and we'll call you battle-ready.

return.0: Good haul. Those yekberries keep fighters standing.
return.1: For now. Come back when you want the advanced method, and I'll show you how to refine food.
return.2: Keep a few slotted and use them before panic takes over. Then we'll upgrade your menu.

player.0: So this is just... survival food?

intro.0: Back for lesson two? Good. Raw food keeps you alive, refined food wins fights.
intro.2: Drop your berries, stomp them into liquid, then report back.

player.0: So spending time on prep actually matters?

stomp.0: Drop your yekberries on the ground and walk over them a few times.
stomp.1: No dainty steps. Mash them like they insulted your knife.

jar.0: Perfect stomp-work. You wrung those berries into liquid.
jar.1: Hands can't hold a puddle, so use a jar. I'll spot you one for free.
jar.2: Next time, you pay. Glass doesn't grow on trees.

collect.0: You made juice, now bottle it. Click the puddle and confirm the pour.
collect.1: One jar in, one serving of Yek Juice out. Chemistry with consequences.

finish.0: Now THAT is proper fuel. Smooth, sharp, and it actually keeps a blade-cat standing.
finish.1: Exactly. Skill in the kitchen is skill in combat, just with fewer screams.
finish.2: Come back later and I'll teach you deadlier recipes. Anchor Hollow feeds those who experiment.

player.0: That healed way better than the raw berries.

intro.0: I heard through the grapevine that you have some money now... are the stories true?
intro.1: Marvelous! A customer with coin is my favorite kind of miracle.
intro.2: Take a look at what I've got. Welcome to the stall!

post.0: You've got the look of a customer now. My wares are ready when you are.
post.1: Back again? Smart fish. Let's see what catches your eye.
post.2: Coins burning a hole in your pocket? I've got just the thing.
post.3: Welcome, welcome! Fresh stock, fair prices. Mostly.

clue.1: Nope. But I heard this: when the sky is dark and the stars glimmer, the moon reveals treasure reflections in the water.
clue.2: If you're key hunting, check the docks at night.

intro.0: Traveler's request: could you bring me 1 yekberry?
intro.1: Specific goals build character. Please and thank you.

collect.0: I still need 1 yekberry. Bring one and I'll make it worth your time.

return.0: You actually came back with a yekberry. You're incredibly kind.
return.1: Confession: this was a social experiment. I wanted to see if Anchor Hollow still had generous people.
return.2: Fair. My budget is... less theatrical.
return.3: I can spare one silver coin. It's not much, but it'll be useful.
return.4: You've never had a coin? What, do you live under a rock?
return.5: A silver coin is worth 100 bronze coins.
return.6: And 100 silver coins make one gold coin.
return.7: One silver might not look like much, but used properly, it can get you what you need.

player.1: I've never had a coin before...

post.0: How's the silver treating you? Spend it wisely, not stylishly.

greeting.0: A quiet mind hears what loud waves hide.

intro.3: I can share a secret. One that lifts weight from your shoulders and opens a whole new world.
intro.4: Good. Speak to the Sea Master.
intro.5: Tell him the collector of glass sent you.

choice.prompt: Do I want to hear it?

reminder.0: Find the Sea Master and say the collector of glass sent you.

goldenberries.name: Golden Berries
goldenberries.description: A rare, sweet berry that restores vitality.

yekberries.name: Yek Berries
yekberries.description: Tart berries from a yekbush. Simple, reliable healing food.

yekjuice.name: Yek Juice
yekjuice.description: Pressed yek juice in drinkable form. Much more nourishing than raw berries.

yekjuiceliquid.name: Yek Juice Liquid
yekjuiceliquid.description: A fresh puddle of crushed yek juice. Collect it with a jar.

jar.name: Jar
jar.description: A glass jar used to gather liquids.

glimmeringkey.name: Glimmering Key
glimmeringkey.description: A pale key that catches moonlight even in murky water.

nightfire_scar.name: Nightfire Scar
nightfire_scar.description: A burning sigil that can awaken a fish into free will.

tuna.name: Tuna
tuna.description: A common tuna fish. Delicious when prepared properly.

mackerel.name: Mackerel
mackerel.description: A sleek mackerel with shimmering scales.

cod.name: Cod
cod.description: A plump cod fish, common in temperate waters.

salmon.name: Salmon
salmon.description: A pink salmon, prized for its rich flavor.

catfish.name: Catfish
catfish.description: A whiskered catfish that lurks in deeper waters.

fat_tuna.name: Fat Tuna
fat_tuna.description: An exceptionally plump tuna. Worth more than its regular counterpart.

fat_mackerel.name: Fat Mackerel
fat_mackerel.description: A chunky mackerel with extra meat.

fat_cod.name: Fat Cod
fat_cod.description: An oversized cod, quite the catch!

fat_salmon.name: Fat Salmon
fat_salmon.description: A hefty salmon bursting with flavor.

fat_catfish.name: Fat Catfish
fat_catfish.description: A massive catfish. Its whiskers are impressively long.

coho_salmon.name: Coho Salmon
coho_salmon.description: A beautiful coho salmon with distinctive silver markings.

rickety_rod.name: Rickety Rod
rickety_rod.description: A worn fishing rod held together with hope and string.

fisherman_rod.name: Fisherman's Rod
fisherman_rod.description: A reliable fishing rod used by experienced anglers.

developer_rod.name: Developer Rod
developer_rod.description: A debug rod tuned for very fast test catches.

sea_grass.name: Sea Grass
sea_grass.description: A clump of sea grass. Not particularly useful.

boot.name: Old Boot
boot.description: A waterlogged boot. Someone lost this ages ago.

broken_bottle.name: Broken Bottle
broken_bottle.description: Shards of a broken glass bottle. Handle with care.

apple_core.name: Apple Core
apple_core.description: The remains of someone's snack. Very fresh, oddly.

trash_bag.name: Trash Bag
trash_bag.description: A soggy trash bag. Who throws these in the water?

sea_pickle.name: Sea Pickle
sea_pickle.description: A bioluminescent sea pickle. Kinda cute, actually.

broken_specs.name: Broken Spectacles
broken_specs.description: Someone's lost glasses. They probably can't read now.

infested_boot.name: Infested Boot
infested_boot.description: An old boot now home to mysterious sea creatures.

infested_vase.name: Infested Vase
infested_vase.description: An ancient vase covered in barnacles. Could be valuable!

ruined_chest.name: Ruined Chest
ruined_chest.description: A waterlogged treasure chest. Most contents have rotted away.
